ExtraBar 1.3.0 – One Menu to Rule Them All! 🎯👁️

✨ What's New

  • Single Menu Mode: Combine ExtraBar's app menu with the bar into one menu bar icon, hide the app icon entirely, or keep them separate – configure it under Settings → General → App Menu!
  • Hide Items: New eye toggle in the menu lets you hide apps, actions, and widgets while preserving their configuration – declutter without losing anything!

🎨 Customization

  • App Icon as Menu Trigger: Pick "App Icon" as the Single Menu icon and it tracks whichever app icon you've selected in Settings – your bar, your look!

⚙️ Settings

  • Hide Keyboard Navigation Labels: New toggle in Hotkeys settings – the number/letter shortcuts keep working, the overlays just don't show!

🐛 Bug Fixes

  • Dual Bar Display: Fixed two bars showing when switching modes – only the active bar appears now!
  • Network Shares: Finder aliases and smb:// / afp:// paths now open correctly from the bar instead of failing or launching the wrong thing!

🚀 What's Next?

We're always working on making ExtraBar more powerful and intuitive! More features and improvements are on the way based on your feedback!

Thank you for being part of the ExtraBar community! Your feedback drives every improvement we make – keep it coming! 💙
